=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3090-3092 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the `if: always()` "Cleanup test artifacts" step, the new first line `declare -F gh_api_retry >/dev/null || source scripts/gh_helpers.sh` has no fallback and runs before the existing fail-soft `source scripts/gh_helpers.sh 2>/dev/null || true`, so under `bash -e` the step exits on line 1 when scripts/gh_helpers.sh is missing.
  WHY: After a failed or missing checkout, the cleanup now stops before it closes the test PR or issue, deletes the branch or cancels in-flight runs, which the code tolerated before this PR; severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated MAJOR, the others NIT, so the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5691 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Cleanup alt-model artifacts" step (`if: always()`) has the same new fail-hard first line `declare -F gh_api_retry >/dev/null || source scripts/gh_helpers.sh` with no fallback.
  WHY: The alt-model cleanup has the same `bash -e` early exit, which leaves test artifacts behind when the helper file is absent; severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated MAJOR, the others NIT, so the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4766-4790 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The validate-standalone-test job's `timeout-minutes` went from 45 to 65, and it got GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS / GH_RETRY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS env with the comment "45 + 20 so one read may wait out a rate-limit reset", but nothing in the job calls gh_api_retry or gh_retry; scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh reads only DISPATCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS.
  WHY: A hung run holds a runner slot 20 minutes longer (§26) for a wait that cannot happen, and the comment misleads whoever sizes this budget next.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3694-3712 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: workflow-log-analysis-test got the `GH_RETRY_*` env, but the PR adds no gh_api_retry call site in this job.
  WHY: Its gh work goes through `gh_api_safe` / dispatch-and-watch, which read neither variable, so the env is inert and misleading.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3901-3919 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: orphan-workflows-test got the `GH_RETRY_*` env, but the PR adds no gh_api_retry call site in this job.
  WHY: The job only reads `update_workflows.yml` runs through paths that do not use the helper, so the env is inert and misleading.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4378-4380 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: orchestrate-decompose-test's limit was raised from 60 to 80 minutes, but the dispatch env comment still says "3000s completion + 240s leaves 360s of the 60 min job for its other steps." and `DISPATCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS` stays at "240".
  WHY: A dispatch whose rate-limit reset is 241-600 s away still gives up at once (dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh line 212, outcome=cap_reached), which contradicts issue change 2 ("raise the step limit rather than shorten the wait").
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:73-117 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `gh_api_retry` calls in check_all_steps() sit inside the existing outer 3-attempt loop (lines 73-80) and the 3-call indexing-delay recheck (lines 100-117), so each helper call's job-level bound (3 attempts, up to 2 × 600 s waits) is multiplied, and no remaining-job-budget cap like Phase 7's exists here.
  WHY: Under a sustained rate limit, one check_all_steps invocation can spend about 120 minutes retrying (about 8 hours across four phases), which exhausts the finalization reserve and gets the job killed at the 360-minute cap instead of failing fast.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py:118-120 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `_GH_CALL` regex only recognises `gh api|run|pr|issue` after a hand-picked set of command-position delimiters, so it misses env-assignment prefixes (`GH_TOKEN=foo gh api ...`), variable expansions (`${X} gh api ...`), function-body opens (`func() { gh api ...`) and heredoc headers, and `test_scanner_recognises_reads_and_writes` exercises none of these forms.
  WHY: A future raw read written with any of those prefixes passes the contract test silently and brings back the bypass the test exists to prevent.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_plan.sh:201 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `LABELS_RECHECK=$(. scripts/gh_helpers.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh_api_retry ...)` sources the helper inside a command substitution with output suppressed, so a missing or broken scripts/gh_helpers.sh fails silently and LABELS_RECHECK becomes an empty string.
  WHY: The other routed step scripts fail closed at the top level, while this recheck goes blind and the `ai:awaiting-approval|ai:implementing` label transition goes unobserved; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this and rejected it, because a failed read falls back to "" exactly as before.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:610-611 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The worst-case single-read wait, (3 - 1) × 600 = 1200 s = 20 min, equals the whole default `E2E_FINALIZATION_RESERVE_MINUTES` of 20, and `test_pat_jobs_bound_helper_waits` asserts `<=`, so there is zero headroom.
  WHY: One read that waits out the full cap uses the entire finalization reserve, so any later finalization or soft-error step pushes the job into its 360-minute cap.
- agents.d/10225-gate-rate-limit-helpers.md:second bullet | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The issue required a registered stable `GATE_RATE_LIMIT` log prefix, but the PR reused `GH_PAT_BUDGET` instead.
  WHY: Log parsers and operators that key on GATE_RATE_LIMIT will not find the expected metrics; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dissent, citing the approved AD-1 decision.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "Add a contract test that fails when one of the five step scripts or the gate workflow contains a raw `gh api`, `gh run`, `gh pr view|list`, `gh issue view|list` read outside an explicit allowlist with a reason per entry. That is what keeps new call sites from bypassing the helper again."

  confidence=5

  EVIDENCE: The `_GH_CALL` prefix set (`^`, `$(`, `[;|&!]`, then/do/if/while/else, `timeout N`, `command`) has no env-assignment prefix (`GH_TOKEN=x gh api ...`), group opener (`{ gh api ...; }`, `( gh api ...)`), variable prefix (`${X} gh api ...`, `$GH_TOKEN gh api ...`), `env gh api ...`, function-body brace or heredoc header, so `raw_reads()` lets those reads through; the scanner self-test covers none of these forms; no such call site exists today (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 grep), so this is a hole in protecting future call sites.
- requirement: "Route every read the gate makes through the existing rate-limit-aware helpers (`gh_retry`, `gh_read`, `_safe_gh_jq` in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`), starting with `phase7_list_cancel_runs()` and the other calls in the five `scripts/stable_e2e_step_*.sh` files, then the inline steps of `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`." The acceptance asks the gate to wait for the reset instead of failing on a rate limit.
